fields.h1: Build Affiliate Automation That Tracks Every Commission
fields.hero_description: Build affiliate automation that approves partners, holds commissions through refunds, and logs payouts in a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What Emergent Builds for an Affiliate Program
fields.features_subheading: Each program runs as one app with its own sign-up form and records, so a balance traces back to its orders.
fields.feature_1:
Describe the program, get the app

Emergent builds the sign-up form, the commission rules, and the affiliate database from a plain-English prompt. When your rate changes, ask for the change in a new prompt.
fields.feature_2:
Orders from Stripe, affiliates in HubSpot

The app connects to any tool with an API. It reads each Stripe order with its referral code, and syncs approved affiliates to HubSpot so your partner team works from one list.
fields.feature_3:
A nudge when a person has to decide

The app sends a Slack message when an application falls under your traffic minimum, and an email reminder if the payout run still waits for approval two days after the 1st.
fields.feature_4:
W-9s on file before the first payout

The app asks each US affiliate for a W-9 and keeps payment records ready for 1099 reporting. It organizes the data for your accountant; it does not file taxes for you.
fields.feature_5:
Every commission in a database you own

Each application, order, commission, and payout is a row in a database you own. There is no task cap, so a launch week with 3,000 referred orders runs like any other week.
fields.feature_6:
The code goes to your GitHub

On paid plans, export the full code of your affiliate app to your GitHub repository. A developer can add a custom credit rule or move hosting without rebuilding the program.

fields.usecase_heading: How Four Affiliate Programs Run Their Rules
fields.tab_content_1:
Bracklin Kitchen gets its code after clearing 10,000 visitors

An application from the Bracklin Kitchen blog reaches Corvelle Tea Company with 42,000 monthly visitors, clearing the 10,000-visitor minimum. The app approves the blog and sends a welcome email with its referral link and the code BRACKLINTEA. Sites under 10,000 wait for the affiliate manager, Kerensa Pembridge.
fields.tab_content_2:
Theo's $36 commission is reversed after the day 12 return

Order #8817 for $240 comes in to Moorcastle Leather through Theo Grainger's referral link. The app credits Theo a $36 commission and holds it for the 30-day refund window. On day 12 the customer returns the bag and Stripe records the refund. The app reverses the $36 and emails Theo the order number.
fields.tab_content_3:
Two payouts for $598.50 wait for Adaeze to approve

On the 1st, Maravel Cycling's app totals each affiliate's approved commissions. Lowgear Commutes is owed $412.50 and Cadence Club $186.00, a $598.50 run that waits for the finance lead, Adaeze Okafor-Vane, to approve. Fernhill Rides has $38.00, under the $50 minimum, and that balance rolls into next month.
fields.tab_content_4:
Of 214 links checked, 3 go to Wes

Every Monday morning the app checks the 214 affiliate links in Trailcairn Reviews' gear posts. Three return an error this week, including a 404 on the two-person tent review. The editor, Wes Quiller, gets a Slack message listing every broken link with its post.

fields.hero_prompt: Build affiliate automation that credits each Stripe order to the referring affiliate and holds the commission for 30 days.

faq_plan.q: How do I set up affiliate automation?

plan.angle: The top 10 are tool listicles and creator guides about posting content on autopilot; none shows an affiliate program running. This page shows the four jobs a merchant or publisher repeats every week, each written down to the rule, the number and the person who handles the exception: an application scored against a traffic minimum, a commission held through the refund window and reversed on a refund, a monthly payout run with a $50 minimum, and a weekly check of every affiliate link on a review site. The how-to has the operator write the commission rules first and replay last month's orders before any payout goes out.
tab_stories: Corvelle Tea Company gets an application from the Bracklin Kitchen blog with 42,000 monthly visitors; it clears the 10,000-visitor minimum, so the app approves it, issues a referral link and the code BRACKLIN10, and sends the welcome email, while smaller sites wait for the affiliate manager, Kerensa Pembridge.

Moorcastle Leather credits order #8817 for $240 to Theo Grainger's referral link and holds his $36 commission for the 30-day refund window; the customer returns the bag on day 12, so the app reverses the commission and emails Theo.

On the 1st, Maravel Cycling's app totals approved commissions per affiliate: $412.50 and $186.00 go into a $598.50 payout run for the finance lead, Adaeze Okafor-Vane, to approve, and a $38.00 balance under the $50 minimum rolls into next month.
Every Monday the app checks the 214 affiliate links across Trailcairn Reviews' gear posts, finds 3 that return an error, and sends the editor, Wes Quiller, a Slack message listing each post and link.
